div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
All transitions shown are built.
Checkout failures return 400/402/409/503, create no order row and send no email (ADR 0018).
Capture outcome may overtake DispatchConfirmed: PaymentCaptured/PaymentFailed are accepted from authorized or dispatched.
Customer cancellation and authorization expiry share the same OrderCancelled fan-out (US-9).
